raw.rationale: Apabetalone is a weak BET bromodomain inhibitor with modest antiproliferative activity, and at 2.5 µM for 5 days it is unlikely to show strong lineage-selective killing; any selectivity would most plausibly arise in BET-dependent hematologic or MYC/BRD4-driven contexts, which are not among the listed lineages. Thus probabilities are low across all listed solid-tumor lineages, near the upper end of the stated base rate only for lineages with occasional BET-inhibitor sensitivity such as colorectal, pancreas, or upper aerodigestive.
